scene.coordinate_convention: polygon and antenna JSON use bottom-origin x,y; image arrays use row=(H-1)-y,col=x; pixel centers are represented by integer grid coordinates

png_gray_mapping.status: repository-established mapping; exact publisher post-processing is not independently recoverable from the PNG files

dataset_labels.physics_prior_quantity: signed_PL_or_pathgain_db; FSPL and diffraction contributions are negative in the final map
dataset_labels.optional_magnitude_quantity: positive loss magnitudes are saved only as *_loss_magnitude_db arrays

physics_prior.owr_cd_algorithm_name: OWR-CD (One-Way Recursive Corner Diffraction; canonical UTD wedge)
physics_prior.auto_selection_rule: For each NLoS Rx, use the dominant root blocking roof height as local reference: OWR-CD when Tx/Rx heights are close and both are below half that height; otherwise use OWR-RD. If strict OWR-CD cannot build a legal chain to Rx, fall back to OWR-RD, then to the root single edge only for pathological raster geometry.
physics_prior.d1_d2_definition: 3D Euclidean distances from the current interval endpoints A/B to candidate rooftop point E=(x,y,H_i), including vertical offsets; for the root interval A=Tx and B=Rx
physics_prior.recursive_same_building_guard: Exclude the already selected 8-connected building component from child intervals so one rasterized roof is not counted as multiple knife edges

visualization.note: These limits are fixed across selected scenes/Tx and are not per-image min-max normalization.
